relations: As the polished metal plate descends, the vertical gap between its lower edge and the mug rim closes progressively.
The mug body buckles under the descending plate, shrinking the yellow oval logo into a sliver behind the crumpled edge.
The deformed skirt at the base stays in contact with the platform, shifting slightly outward as the body flattens.
The wire handle tilts toward the base while a faint mist persists around the contact area.
caption: The video captures a hydraulic press in close-up as it steadily crushes a black mug. The yellow-and-black striped upper block connects to a polished metal plate pressing down onto the mug, which bears a yellow oval Batman logo and a wire handle on the right. The mug rests on a flat metal base, its lower rim already crumpled outward, with a thin haze around the contact area. Throughout the excerpt the plate moves downward, the vertical gap between its lower edge and the mug's rim closing progressively. The mug body visibly buckles as the plate descends, the yellow logo shrinking from a clear oval into a sliver hidden behind the crumpled edge. The deformed skirt at the base stays in contact with the platform, shifting slightly outward as the body flattens, while the handle tilts a little toward the base. The faint mist persists around the base, and the background remains a soft, out-of-focus greenish blur.
